verdict.rationale: Wise documents a broad API surface covering multi-currency accounts and transfers, batches, cards, spend controls, disputes, support cases, statements and webhook management, so much of the product is reachable programmatically. However, no source claims full API/UI parity, and some flows are delivered as Wise-hosted Embedded or Dynamic Flows rather than pure API calls. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence that every UI action (e.g. account administration, Wise Business settings) has an API equivalent, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: How to make business payments via API from a Wise account.
Cases enable you to open, retrieve, and respond to support and operations queries through direct API.
The Wise multi-currency account (MCA) enables users to hold, convert, and fund transfers (single or batches) with balances in up to 56 currencies.
Raise and manage card transaction disputes, including submission via Dynamic Flow or direct API, file uploads, and dispute lifecycle tracking.
Embedded Flows are Wise-hosted flows that partners can open for their users or embed inside their own product with an iframe or mobile WebView.
Manage webhook subscriptions at both the application and profile level. Create, list, retrieve, and delete subscriptions, as well as test your webhook endpoints.
